Per the PRODUCT_DEFECT exclusion, a disagreement between an assertion and a value cannot reach PRODUCT_DEFECT when the test's own expectation is the sole statement of what is correct. The case sits between PRODUCT_DEFECT and TEST_CODE_DEFECT (a stale or wrong hard-coded expectation); the deciding evidence would be an independent statement of the correct invoice total, such as a pricing contract or the test's pass history against an unchanged test file."}
